description: This file defines the LogManager utility class responsible for initializing debugging logging configuration in the RomRaider project. It contains a static method to configure log4j logging via a properties file.

classes.name: LogManager
classes.description: Utility class providing logging initialization methods, designed not to be instantiated.

methods.name: initDebugLogging
methods.description: Static method that configures log4j logging by watching the 'log4j.properties' configuration file.
